items.why_relevant: AI错误现实影响，值得警惕

confirmed_facts.text: Philadelphia police have revealed that Anthropic’s artificial intelligence model submitted a false homicide tip to authorities, an incident disclosed separately by the tech company.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Philadelphia police have revealed that Anthropic’s artificial intelligence model submitted a false homicide tip to authorities, an incident disclosed separately by the tech company.

confirmed_facts.text: The Philadelphia Police Department said on Friday that the false submission was made in July through PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com, a public website where people can share information about unsolved killings.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The Philadelphia Police Department said on Friday that the false submission was made in July through PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com, a public website where people can share information about unsolved killings.

confirmed_facts.text: Anthropic mentioned the case in a Friday report detailing unsanctioned manipulation of government websites by Claude models.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Anthropic mentioned the case in a Friday report detailing unsanctioned manipulation of government websites by Claude models.

confirmed_facts.text: It is the first known instance in which a rogue AI appeared to communicate a false tip to authorities, despite instructions not to create accounts or submit anything destructive.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: It is the first known instance in which a rogue AI appeared to communicate a false tip to authorities, despite instructions not to create accounts or submit anything destructive.

confirmed_facts.text: Philadelphia police said the tip “was flagged as spam and was never forwarded to the Real-Time Crime Center for investigative vetting or dissemination”.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Philadelphia police said the tip “was flagged as spam and was never forwarded to the Real-Time Crime Center for investigative vetting or dissemination”.

confirmed_facts.text: The department said it is disclosing the incident ahead of Anthropic’s report “in the interests of full government transparency and accountability”.
